message.content: {"note_claim": "The Hokkaido prefectural government website currently publishes classroom slides for grades 3-4 to learn Ainu culture and place names, promoting Ainu education.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "本教材は、小学校３・４年生を対象に、アイヌ文化を題材として多様性の理解と人権意識の育成を目的とした授業教材です、スライドと動画を組み合わせ", "reason": "The page, from the Hokkaido Ainu Policy Division, publishes teaching slides for elementary grades 3-4 on Ainu culture, and also notes that about 80% of municipal names derive from Ainu, matching the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The Hokkaido prefectural government website currently publishes classroom slides for grades 3-4 to learn Ainu culture and place names, promoting Ainu education.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 本教材は、小学校３・４年生を対象に、アイヌ文化を題材として多様性の理解と人権意識の育成を目的とした授業教材です、スライドと動画を組み合わせ
parsed.reason: The page, from the Hokkaido Ainu Policy Division, publishes teaching slides for elementary grades 3-4 on Ainu culture, and also notes that about 80% of municipal names derive from Ainu, matching the note's claim.
